import sys, torch
sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from torchoed import optimal_design, polynomial_features
torch.set_num_threads(1)

F=polynomial_features(C,degree=2)
result=optimal_design(F,20,criterion='A',restarts=1,generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(0))
print(result['ids'].tolist(),flush=True)
